phrases.text: Honestly, I don't know what to wear tonight.
I want to be casual and simple.
I love these jeans. They're from Zara, and lately I've been obsessed with them.
And this is the belt I'm gonna use.
It's been with me for decades.
It's giving the seat belt in the airplane.
And I have this long sleeve that I want to wear tonight. This is from a Russian brand.
I really like the sleeves because they're giving the same vibe as the jeans.
For the shoes, I'm gonna wear these boots. They're also from Zara.
And now the hardest part is to choose which coat I want to wear.
I know that I have one coat that's gonna be very nice in this outfit,
but I don't want to wear it because I've been wearing this for the last week, non-stop.
You see, it's nice.
The first option is a leather jacket.
Actually, it's not bad.
This is another option with another leather jacket.
I really like this washed brown color.
Okay, the last one is a bit oversized black coat.
I think it looks nice too, but I don't know if it's a vibe.
I think we're ready!
I decided to go with this almost black leather jacket and this bag that I wanted.
I made some messy hair. I have my favorite rings on.
For the perfume, I decided to go with Kilian, A Taste of Heaven.
I'm obsessed with heavy smells.
Let me know, guys: what do you think about this look?
Bye! I'm gonna get drunk.
